nom: Curology Clear Pimple Patch Clusters for Face

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: one had a welt-like, irritated reaction on three blemish sites, another found her face too sensitive for the patches to use at all, while a third with self-described super sensitive skin reported no irritation whatsoever.

concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reported the patches left irritated, welt-like marks on three separate blemish sites; another reviewer who describes her skin as super sensitive, however, said the patches never irritated her skin at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report the patches visibly draw out oil and gunk from clustered breakouts and whiteheads within hours to about a day, with some describing pimples resolved within 30 minutes to a year of stubborn use; one reviewer, however, hadn't seen any noticeable change on her chin after her first few uses.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers report the patches visibly pull oil and gunk out of clogged pores, leaving skin feeling smoother and cleaner after just one use.

aspects.libelle: Sticks well and stays on for hours, even under moisturizer
Thin and comfortable, unnoticeable while sleeping
Covers larger, clustered areas better than single spot patches
Peels off easily without hardening or hurting

extraits.texte: Be careful is you have sensitive skin. Left an irritated mark. I had a blemish on my upper arms and back and left a welt on all 3 spots.

I loved these way better than the spot patches merely because they are more catered to breakouts and cover more surface area atonce time. I left it on for 24hrs to ensure that all of the oil and gunk was removed.

I like these acne patches so far. I put them on at night since they can stay on for up to 6 hours. I haven’t seen any noticeable change on my chin so far after use. I’m hoping they start to work eventually.

Curology crushed the pimple patch game. these work so quickly and get so much out of your pores! Leaves your face feeling so smooth and clean after one use. Pros: - do not hurt when peeling off of your face like other brands have in the past to me - the size of them works great for a bunch of problem areas where you need oil/pores cleaned out - do not feel them on your face if sleeping with them on - i have used these for 3hours up to 8 hours and even for the shorter time frames they still pull a ton out - do not irritate the skin (i have super sensitive skin) - They do not get hard and “crunchy” like other brands Cons: - not one complaint about these at all!
Love this brand!! Works great on my chin and nose. Sucks us lots of oil and works wonders in pimples with a whitehead!
Bought these, unfortunately my face is too sensitive for them, but they’re pretty good quality.
